page.layout: Two columns of index entries on the left printed page, with page numbers at the end of each entry. The right-hand printed page is only the cut-off edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Running head at top; catchword at bottom right.

page.notes: Long s is written as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "eam" in the Libertas directa entry (printed form unclear, marked [?]); the number after "ad Littus" line appears to be 181 with a stray mark. The entry "Libertas est favorabilior lucro / pecuniario" runs over the column break and is kept as two printed lines. Star marks (*) and the dashes after numbers are as printed or as far as visible. Printing errors such as "353.5" and the missing comma in "LegeAquilia" are left as printed. The right-hand page edge, show-through and the library stamp are omitted.
